method: Independent explicit complex 9x9 branch-current MNA, 5 LPF node voltages+4 chip-L currents, full mandatory two S2Ps, source 50ohm/1Vrms and load 60-j40ohm. Physical inductors order [L0,L1,L3,L2]. Magnetic Q equals omega*Re(I^H Lmatrix I)/(I^H R I), R_ii=omega Li/25. Reduced-ABCD original check confirms baseline IL exactly at 803MHz and 960MHz.

validation.js_basis: independent 9x9 MNA using main-branch unchanged S2P content and checkpoint values

k_perturbation.policy: change only k(L1,L3), keep both saturating other k and all L/C/settings unchanged
k_perturbation.frequency_sweep: 28 CSV frequency intervals x31 points, endpoints inclusive
k_perturbation.warning: Non-original k cases are NOT RF-T005 feasible at fixed C; no reoptimization performed.

interpretation: In the approved model mutual inductance is reactive: fixed Q of each L remains 25.
Driven magnetic Q can improve above 25 with favorable coupling relative phases, but coil RMS currents also change.
At B28 803MHz strengthening middle coupling raises magnetic Q 25.482→25.682 while absolute ohmic coil dissipation 0.305714→0.308175mW and IL 0.811307→0.814157dB.
The middle coupling k=0.060185... is deliberately constrained by H2/H3 notch positions and full-band minimax matching, not because Q improvement is impossible.
2/3 adjacent k saturated: L0-L1=+0.1 and L3-L2=-0.1.
The unequal branch current amplitudes (L1,L2 shunts << L0,L3 main transmission arms) bound achievable mutual energy fraction despite k=0.1.
limitations: Local 31 point per range perturbation screen; baseline independently compared with prior 1001 point official checkpoint.
Fixed L and C for k perturbations: not a proof of reoptimized full-k feasibility.
No Q(f), SRF, EM, physical signed mutual feasibility, tolerance. S2P are fixed model not measurements.
